Generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py — do not edit. One row per key of `contracts/config/balance.json`, grouped by category (Q-CFG-15). Edit the schema, then run `make contracts`. A dash in a block still listed in `PENDING_BLOCKS` means the field is not annotated yet. Tune ranges are PROPOSED sweep ranges, not validation; the schema bounds are the validation.
